The 21 section fragmentsshipped

Every page composed from stacked section shortcodes rather than one monolith per page.

18 original + 3 for Contact. The five legacy whole-page fragments were retired on 2026-08-13 — they had drifted from the sections they duplicated while STATUS described them as working.

Editable sections (ACF)shipped

19 sections editable in wp-admin — 88 fields, no import step, a field change goes live on push.

Declare a slot in sections/<id>/slots.json, run kit/build-acf.py, push. brg-acf.php fetches the generated groups from Netlify and registers them. Four sections stay as code pending repeaters.

Repeater supportplanned

Repeating rows so the crew grid, core values, LinkedIn posts and brand plates become editable.

The last gap in 'anything editable at any point'. Flat slots would bake in a count we know changes — core values already went 6 to 5. Needs a repeater slot type, a repeating fill in the plugin, and a row-template convention.

Self-deploying WordPress pluginshipped

A push touching website/wp-mu-plugin/ deploys the PHP and verifies the version that landed on the server.

scp succeeding only proves bytes moved, so the run SSHes back in and greps VCC_VERSION out of the deployed file. Retired the manual plugin drop entirely.

Contact pagebuilding

Three sections, 19 slots, built and deployed — waiting on the WP page and a form destination.

No map embed: a third-party map inlined into WordPress means cookies, a consent banner and a second JS engine.

Hero underline reworkplanned

Approved. Today the careers marker is several times wider than the word it underlines. Two MIT reference implementations supplied; the underlined text must never wrap.
